_comment: Route pairs for dnn-visual-diff. Provenance: production sitemap (sitemap.aspx, 18 URLs, measured 2026-09-08) + #1180/#1066 measurements. Marker semantics: expected_markers compare the observed build markers against what was declared — outcome 'matched' / 'mismatched' / 'none-declared' (an empty dict declares NOTHING). This is NOT a freshness protocol: freshness stays 'unknown' in every case (no independent deployment proof exists client-side); 'mismatched' is an explicit route error. Key syntax: 'field>' / 'field=' / 'field!=' with the operand as value (e.g. {"tosic_sexycontent>": "0"}).
